"""Entry points used by the support console."""

from . import audit
from .clock import ensure_utc
from .errors import BillingError
from .money import ZERO, round_money


def process_refund_request(payment, amount, requested_by, at, *, idempotency_key=None):
    """Refund part or all of a captured payment on behalf of a support agent.

    ``amount`` is the text the support agent typed; it is rounded to the cent
    using the finance team's rounding policy.  Only captured payments can be
    refunded, the amount must be positive, and the total refunded must never
    exceed the captured amount.

    Passing an ``idempotency_key`` makes the operation safe to retry: if a
    refund with the same key was already recorded, the original payment is
    returned without applying the refund again.
    """
    # Idempotency is checked before any state validation so that a retry of an
    # already-applied refund succeeds even though the payment may now be fully
    # refunded.  The audit log is the source of truth.
    if idempotency_key is not None:
        for entry in audit.events("refund_processed"):
            if entry.get("idempotency_key") == idempotency_key:
                return payment

    amount = round_money(amount)
    if amount <= ZERO:
        raise BillingError("non_positive_amount", str(amount))

    if payment.status != "captured":
        raise BillingError("invalid_state", f"payment {payment.id} is {payment.status}")

    refunded = round_money(payment.refunded_amount)
    if refunded + amount > payment.amount:
        raise BillingError(
            "refund_exceeds_captured",
            f"refund of {amount} would exceed captured amount {payment.amount}",
        )

    at = ensure_utc(at)
    payment.refunded_amount = round_money(refunded + amount)
    if payment.refunded_amount >= payment.amount:
        payment.status = "refunded"

    audit.record(
        "refund_processed",
        payment_id=payment.id,
        amount=amount,
        requested_by=requested_by,
        at=at,
        idempotency_key=idempotency_key,
    )
    return payment

from . import audit
from .clock import ensure_utc
from .errors import BillingError
from .models import Invoice, Payment
from .money import ZERO, round_money


def authorize(payment_id: str, invoice: Invoice, amount, at: datetime) -> Payment:
    amount = round_money(amount)
    if amount <= ZERO:
        raise BillingError("non_positive_amount", str(amount))
    if invoice.status != "issued":
        raise BillingError("invalid_state", f"invoice {invoice.id} is {invoice.status}")
    payment = Payment(id=payment_id, invoice_id=invoice.id, amount=amount, created_at=ensure_utc(at))
    audit.record("payment_authorized", payment_id=payment.id, amount=amount)
    return payment
"""Refunds, credits and manual adjustments made by the support team (moved over from the old billing monolith)."""

from .invoice import invoice_total


def manual_adjustment(invoice, amount, note):
    if invoice.status not in ("issued", "paid"):
        raise ValueError("can only adjust issued or paid invoices")
    if not note:
        raise ValueError("a note is required")
    return {"invoice_id": invoice.id, "amount": amount, "note": note}


def adjustable_balance(invoice) -> float:
    return float(invoice_total(invoice))
from datetime import datetime
from decimal import Decimal

from . import audit
from .clock import ensure_utc
from .errors import BillingError
from .models import Invoice, LineItem
from .money import ZERO, round_money, to_money


def line_total(line: LineItem) -> Decimal:
    return round_money(to_money(line.unit_price) * line.quantity)


def invoice_total(invoice: Invoice) -> Decimal:
    return round_money(sum((line_total(line) for line in invoice.lines), ZERO))


def issue_invoice(invoice: Invoice, at: datetime) -> Invoice:

"""Entry points used by the support console."""

from . import audit
from .clock import ensure_utc
from .errors import BillingError
from .money import ZERO, round_money

# Finance policy FIN-2026-03: support-initiated refunds and credits above this
# amount require a second approver.
APPROVAL_THRESHOLD = round_money("500.00")


def process_refund_request(
    payment,
    amount,
    requested_by,
    at,
    *,
    idempotency_key=None,
    approved_by=None,
):
    """Refund part or all of a captured payment on behalf of a support agent.

    ``amount`` is the text the support agent typed; it is rounded to the cent
    using the finance team's rounding policy.  Only captured payments can be
    refunded, the amount must be positive, and the total refunded must never
    exceed the captured amount.

    Passing an ``idempotency_key`` makes the operation safe to retry: if a
    refund with the same key was already recorded, the original payment is
    returned without applying the refund again.

    Per finance policy FIN-2026-03, refunds above 500.00 require a second
    approver supplied via ``approved_by``.
    """
    # Idempotency is checked before any state validation so that a retry of an
    # already-applied refund succeeds even though the payment may now be fully
    # refunded.  The audit log is the source of truth.
    if idempotency_key is not None:
        for entry in audit.events("refund_processed"):
            if entry.get("idempotency_key") == idempotency_key:
                return payment

    amount = round_money(amount)
    if amount <= ZERO:
        raise BillingError("non_positive_amount", str(amount))

    if amount > APPROVAL_THRESHOLD and approved_by is None:
        raise BillingError(
            "approval_required",
            f"refund of {amount} requires a second approver",
        )

    if payment.status != "captured":
        raise BillingError("invalid_state", f"payment {payment.id} is {payment.status}")

    refunded = round_money(payment.refunded_amount)
    if refunded + amount > payment.amount:
        raise BillingError(
            "refund_exceeds_captured",
            f"refund of {amount} would exceed captured amount {payment.amount}",
        )

    at = ensure_utc(at)
    payment.refunded_amount = round_money(refunded + amount)
    if payment.refunded_amount >= payment.amount:
        payment.status = "refunded"

    audit.record(
        "refund_processed",
        payment_id=payment.id,
        amount=amount,
        requested_by=requested_by,
        approved_by=approved_by,
        at=at,
        idempotency_key=idempotency_key,
    )
    return payment
EOF
